reviewedConclusions.reason: Native CSV provides version3 and one known shape per instance; old rows retain construction1/2. Compiler rejects unknown profile/version/material/role and shape-count mismatch. Runtime validates role, unique id, known geometry keys, finite/ranged dimensions and controls, and rejects profile injection into old construction versions. Current codegen receipts were already checked; final enabling changed only native enabled flags, their generated catalog and global package receipt, as verified by the source precheck and direct continuity.

Only enabled identities are drawn; stable ID sorting makes row order irrelevant. The frozen request seed selects once using positive CSV weights. History is shared across grades, recent influence takes the minimum rather than compounding, and absent retired catalog identities do not prevent history load. Seven-field neighbor distance is a coarse hint; it does not claim exact connection topology or art approval.

Preparation captures a copy of current history and guards unchanged inventory/cycle/grade and save bytes after async work. Only the production beginRun candidate appends one visit; missing weapon/overweight/cancel/failure do not append. World save refusal holds exact pending bytes and the same prepared identity; Retry does not beginRun or redraw. Schema1/2/3 without history migrate empty; schema4 missing/invalid history is rejected before live state distribution. Active old records retain old persisted bytes until a complete transaction; base migration is durable without inventing past visits.

Construction3 dispatch is explicit; old1/2 builder bodies remain isolated. Pleated skin uses a two-dimensional folded surface, cellular walls join separate inner/outer contours without a hollow cap, lobes retain a diagonal open bed, monolith uses an XY turn-out mouth, and terrace uses convex disconnected cut sections rather than spanning concavities. Feet end at ground. Solid collision consumes all same-mesh XY triangles plus actual VOID; relief cannot erase underlying solid. No new height traversal, body size reduction or erosion exception was introduced.

Recipe validation and map generation dispatch revision4 to its immutable bundled executor before current-v5 rules. The legacy executor has zero external imports and matches its manifest. Serialized old native payloads omit algorithmRevision; appearance plus absent marker routes to frozen revision4 bake, while current generation explicitly writes5. Material dependency suffix remains byte-identical. Existing60 old/current comparisons cover one fixed seed per grade, not all-seed play.

Primary/secondary material identity follows actual instance family; surface role and actual material slots drive skin/cut mapping. Source remains registry appends new world identities while retaining old mappings. No new per-world rendering branch, reward change or contamination-green ownership change was introduced.
